kebab_example: aliyun cr list-repository --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --repo-status ALL --repo-name repo-test --repo-namespace-name repo-namespace-test --page-no 1 --page-size 30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRepository

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Container Registry instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Repository status. Valid values:

- `NORMAL`: Normal.

- `DELETING`: Deleting.

- `DELETED`: Deleted.

- `ALL`: All repository statuses
parameters.help_zh:
仓库状态，取值：

- `NORMAL`：正常。

- `DELETING`：删除中。

- `DELETED`：已删除。

- `ALL`：所有仓库状态
parameters.name: repo_status

parameters.help_en: The name of the namespace to which the repository belongs
parameters.name: repo_namespace_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. If you specify a value larger than 100 for this parameter, the system reports a parameter error or uses 100 as the maximum value
parameters.help_zh: 每页展示的列表数，上限为 100。如果传入的值超过 100，系统将报参数错误或以 100 作为实际返回的列表数上限
parameters.name: page_size
